subtitle: Lesson 5 · Docker Fundamentals

code:
services:
  api:
    build: .
    ports: ["8000:8000"]
    depends_on: [redis]
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports: ["6379:6379"]
caption: api builds from a Dockerfile; redis just pulls a published image.

code:
docker compose up -d        # build + start every service
docker compose ps           # list this project's containers
docker compose logs -f api  # stream one service's logs by name
docker compose down         # stop + remove everything
caption: up replaces running docker build and docker run for each service by hand.
A service started by `docker compose up` lands in this exact same view.
docker logs, exec, and stop from Lesson 4 all still work on a Compose-started container.
